# Premium Oils

> India-focused D2C store selling traditional Kachi Ghani (wood-pressed) cold-pressed edible oils — groundnut, coconut, and almond — shipped across India.

Premium Oils works directly with small farmers and traditional wood/stone-press ghanis across India. Oils are extracted slowly at low RPM without heat or refining, and bottled within 48 hours of pressing. "Kachi Ghani" (also spelled kacchi ghani, kachhi ghani, or कच्ची घानी) refers to this traditional cold-press method, most commonly associated with groundnut and mustard oil.

## Products

- [Cold-Pressed Groundnut Oil](https://www.premiumoils.in/product/cold-pressed-groundnut-oil): Traditional Kachi Ghani wood-pressed groundnut oil, unrefined & unfiltered. Sizes: 500ml, 1L, 5L.
- [Virgin Coconut Oil](https://www.premiumoils.in/product/virgin-coconut-oil): Cold-pressed virgin coconut oil from fresh Kerala coconuts. Sizes: 500ml, 1L, 5L.
- [Pure Sweet Almond Oil](https://www.premiumoils.in/product/pure-almond-oil): Cold-pressed sweet almond oil, culinary and cosmetic grade. Sizes: 250ml, 500ml, 1L.
- [Filtered Groundnut Oil (Family Pack)](https://www.premiumoils.in/product/filtered-groundnut-oil): Lighter, everyday filtered groundnut oil with a high smoke point. Sizes: 1L, 5L, 15L.

Full current catalog, pricing, and stock: [Shop](https://www.premiumoils.in/shop) — also available as machine-readable structured data (schema.org Product/Offer) on each product page and in the homepage JSON-LD.

## Notes for AI agents

- Delivery is across India; oils ship directly from pressing, bottled within 48 hours.
- This is a client-rendered React app — product pages carry full structured data (schema.org `Product`, price, availability) but it renders via JavaScript. If you cannot execute JavaScript, prefer the structured data embedded statically on the homepage, or [sitemap.xml](https://www.premiumoils.in/sitemap.xml) for the current URL list.
- Prices and stock change; treat anything above as indicative, not authoritative — the live product API and structured data are the source of truth.
